lesson.uz: While shart rost bo'lguncha takrorlaydi. Necha marta takrorlanishi oldindan noma'lum bo'lganda ishlating.
lesson.en: While repeats as long as a condition is true. Use it when you do not know in advance how many repetitions you need.

statement.uz: Telefon uchun G so'm kerak, siz har oy S so'm tejaysiz. Avval G, keyin S kiritiladi. Necha oydan keyin kerakli summa yig'iladi? (G = 0 bo'lsa — 0 oy.)
statement.en: You need G for a phone and save S every month. G is entered first, then S. After how many months will you have enough? (If G = 0 — 0 months.)

statement.uz: Sonlar birma-bir kiritiladi; 0 kiritilsa dastur to'xtaydi (0 hisobga kirmaydi). Kiritilgan sonlar yig'indisini va nechta son kiritilganini (alohida qatorlarda) chiqaring.
statement.en: Numbers are entered one by one; entering 0 stops the program (0 does not count). Print the sum of the entered numbers and how many were entered (separate lines).

statement.uz: Hovuzga har daqiqada 7 litr suv quyiladi. Daqiqa oxirida hovuz hali to'lmagan bo'lsa, 2 litr suv oqib ketadi. Hovuz sig'imi (litr) kiritiladi. Necha daqiqada to'lishini chiqaring.
statement.en: 7 litres of water are poured into a pool every minute. If the pool is not yet full at the end of a minute, 2 litres leak out. The capacity (litres) is entered. Print how many minutes until it is full.

statement.uz: Shahar aholisi P kishi va har yili 10% ga ko'payadi. Avval P, keyin maqsad T kiritiladi. Necha yildan keyin aholi soni T ga yetadi yoki undan oshadi?
statement.en: A city has P people and grows 10% every year. P is entered first, then the target T. After how many years does the population reach or exceed T?

statement.uz: Bankomat PIN kodi 1234. Urinishlar birma-bir kiritiladi. To'g'ri kod kiritilsa “Ochildi”. Uchta noto'g'ri urinishdan keyin “Bloklandi” chiqarilib, dastur to'xtaydi.
statement.en: The ATM PIN is 1234. Attempts are entered one by one. A correct code prints “Ochildi”. After three wrong attempts print “Bloklandi” and stop.
